newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - LSI Logic FY97 estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - LSI Logic FY97 estimate cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co Wednesday lowered its estimate for LSI Logic Corp's fiscal 1997 earnings to $1.50 from $1.60 a share.

-- Gruntal said the company has experienced stronger orders from its networking and workstation customers, although its fourth-quarter earnings of $0.23 per share was slightly below Gruntal's estimate of $0.24.
-- Gruntal added that revenue in the period was relatively flat and is not expected to show a marked improvement until the second half of 1997.
-- Gruntal also introduced an estimate for fiscal 1998 earnings of $1.80 a share.
-- LSI Logic designs and makes integrated circuits.
-- Its shares were up 1-1/2 Wednesday at 35-1/2
